_notes: 1. Index 18067-18068: Ezek 36:27-28 canticle verses. 思高 uses '我的神' (divine spirit) in v.27 — kept verbatim per 思高 rule. 2. 'Canticum Habacuc' heading translated as 哈巴谷赞主曲 following liturgical pattern. 3. 'Hab 3:2-33' (index 18081) appears to be a citation range for the second version of the canticle — rendered as 哈 3:2-3:3 following best-guess of intended range; the '33' may be a typo or page artifact for '3:3'. 4. First set (18071-18080) uses Vulgate sub-versification (3:1=inscription heading content, 3:2 split into parts, etc.); second set (18082-18098) uses slightly different verse labels. Both mapped to 思高 ch.3 text as closely as possible. 5. 'diábolus' (3:5/3:9) in the Habakkuk canticle context means pestilence/plague (Latin rendering of Hebrew resheph), not 'devil' — 思高 renders as '热症' following Hebrew; kept 思高 wording. 6. Æthiópiæ (3:12) → 思高 has '雇商' (Cushan); Mádian → 米德杨. These are 思高's renderings used verbatim. 7. Verse 3:13 in second set (index 18093) expands the Latin rhetorical questions following 思高 v.8 structure. 8. Pharan/帕兰山 is the 思高 transliteration for mount Paran.
